subject: Arclight AI — Request for one-off POC credit & short extension
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@arclight.ai>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick ask — additional POC credits & two-week window?

Hi Avery,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the Arclight team is excited about the latency gains we saw. We started the POC last Monday but ran into procurement delay (legal needs a contract addendum and SSO review) that will push our evaluation beyond the standard 14-day PLG window.

Two asks: can Redwood provide a one-off top-up of credits equivalent to roughly $8k (we estimate ~50k additional tokens) to cover the remainder of the POC, and grant a two-week extension on the free evaluation while procurement finishes? This is one-time — procurement will sign PO/SOW as soon as legal is done.

Attached is our current usage snapshot and a short note from our engineering lead on expected token burn. Can we get an expedited decision? We have execs lined up next Wed and want to avoid restarting the trial.

Thanks,
Elena Park
Head of Product
Arclight AI
[Attachment: arclight_usage_nov.csv (csv)]

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@arclight.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick ask — additional POC credits & two-week window?

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and the usage file.

I understand the procurement holdup. I can escalate a one-off credit + extension to our deal desk and request exec signoff given the timeline. Can you confirm the exact token estimate (50k tokens = $8k in your note?) and confirm you'll sign SOW/PO once legal clears? If you can reply quickly I will open the approval request today.

Best,
Avery
Avery Johnson
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 10:20:00 -0800
Subject: Request: one-off POC credit & extension for Arclight AI — DL-202611-4371

Hi Markus / Grace,

Looping you both for a decision. Prospect: Arclight AI (deal DL-202611-4371). They are mid-PLG POC and hit a procurement/legal delay that will push them out of the free evaluation window. Key ask: one-time top-up of credits (~50k tokens / ~$8k credit) and a two-week extension on the free trial while procurement finalizes SOW/PO.

Why this matters:
- Customer showed strong intent: demo ran well, internal roadmap exec review scheduled next Wed.
- Usage indicates likely conversion if the POC continues uninterrupted (see attached usage + short engineering note).
- Loss risk: if we force them to restart, momentum drops and deal timing slips to next quarter.

Attachments: arclight_usage_nov.csv, poc_scope_of_work_v2.pdf, proposed_terms_redline.docx
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/DL-202611-4371
Estimated ARR: $120k ARR in year 1 if closed.

Requested approval options:
A) Exec signoff: Approve full one-off credit $8k + 2-week extension (preferred)
B) Deal desk only: Approve $5k credit + 1-week extension (partial)

If you want, I can restrict credits to a sandbox seat and mark terms on HubSpot and the SOW. Please advise and I’ll notify the customer immediately.

Thanks,
Avery

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 14:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: one-off POC credit & extension for Arclight AI — DL-202611-4371

Avery — thanks for the context and attachments. Quick thoughts:

- Usage looks legit; conversion probability reasonable.
- I can approve up to $5k in credits under normal deal-desk authority but need Grace for anything above that.
- Please confirm restrictions: credits applied to project token budget only (no refunds), start date when procurement confirms, and we require signed SOW or PO within 10 business days of extension end.

If you can get Elena to confirm the token accounting and commit to signing SOW/PO once legal clears, I’m inclined to recommend exec signoff. Looping Grace for final say — @Grace, is $8k + 2 weeks an acceptable one-off given the ARR here?

— Markus
Director, Deal Desk | Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: one-off POC credit & extension for Arclight AI — DL-202611-4371

Thanks Markus/Avery — reviewed. Approve exec exception under these conditions:

1) One-time credit: $8,000 applied to POC token usage only; non-transferable, no refunds.
2) Extension: two weeks beyond current PLG window; new expiry set to 2026-12-13.
3) Signed SOW/PO must be received within 10 business days after the extension expires; if not, credits are voided and normal billing resumes.
4) Update HubSpot deal record with the credit line item and tag this change as "exec-credited-11-29-26".

Avery — please update the HubSpot record and send the DocuSign SOW link to Arclight. Markus — apply the credit to their sandbox account and mark it as executed.

I’m approving because the upside ARR is material ($120k) and interruption risk is high. This is a one-time exception; we do not change standard PLG policy.

Grace O'Connor
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@arclight.ai>, procurement@arclight.ai
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 16:40:00 -0800
Subject: Approved — Arclight one-time POC credit & extension (next steps)

Hi Elena — good news: we have exec approval. Per Grace's signoff we will: 

- Apply a one-time $8,000 credit to the POC token budget (non-transferable).
- Extend your free evaluation window by two weeks; new expiry: 2026-12-13.

Next steps for you:
1) Please review and sign the SOW/PO — DocuSign link here: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/to/Arclight-POC-SOW
2) Confirm the engineering token estimate (50k) in reply so we can tag the credit correctly.

Notes/conditions: credits are voided if we do not receive a signed SOW/PO within 10 business days after the extension ends.

If you want I can schedule a 15-minute sync with legal/procurement to help unblock their review.

Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: poc_scope_of_work_v2.pdf (pdf), proposed_terms_redline.docx (docx)]
